definitions.explanation: The act of remembering or honoring a person, event, or date.

examples.japanese: {記念|きねん}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{記念|きねん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{記念|きねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received it as a graduation memento.

notes:
{記念|きねん} refers to the act of commemorating or remembering something significant. It can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({記念|きねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記念|きねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMPOUNDS:
- {記念|きねん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧: anniversary, memorial day
- {記念|きねん}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: souvenir, memento
- {記念|きねん}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: commemorative photo
- {記念|きねん}⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧: commemorative stamp
- {記念|きねん}⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧: commemoration ceremony

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記念|きねん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧: in commemoration of ~
- 〜{記念|きねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as a memento of ~

USAGE:
Often used with events like ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{記念|きねん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧ (wedding anniversary), ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{記念|きねん} (graduation memento), or ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧{記念|きねん} (store opening commemoration).
